title: D2P Solver Profile
description: Versioned vocabulary of drape solver parameters (design decision ADR-029 §5, ADR-021 §4): profile kind, rest-mesh profile, fixed time stepping, gravity, damping, pre-positioning, collision, equilibrium criterion, failure limits and budget. Any conforming solver may implement a profile; the parameters describe the required behaviour, not one algorithm. Files are stored as vocabularies/solver-profiles/<local>-<version>.json for profileId d2p:<local>.

schemaVersion.description: Full SemVer of the standard release this document was written against.

profileId.description: Qualified name of the profile; with version it identifies the profile.

version.description: Version of the profile, independent of the standard version.

status.description: provisional: proposed values, not to be used for comparing implementations; frozen: adopted and immutable (a changed value is a new version).

profileKind.description: Profile family (design decision ADR-021 §4, ADR-029 §5 rule 3): 'fit-approximation' (fast, coarse mesh, fit impression in seconds) or 'physical-cloth' (finer mesh, material physics, credible drape).

meshProfile.description: Mesh profile (d2p:mesh-profile) the rest meshes of the panels are built with.

toleranceProfile.description: Tolerance profile drapes of this profile are compared with across implementations.

damping.description: Velocity damping per step (dimensionless, 0 = none, 1 = full).

prepositioning.description: How panels are placed around the body before sewing.

failureLimits.description: Limits beyond which a drape is failed with diagnostics, never a released result (SIM-007, DRP-002).

budget.description: Run-time and memory budget of one drape job (DRP-007).

notes.description: Free-text notes on provenance and status of the values.

solverIntegration.title: Solver integration
solverIntegration.description: Fixed time stepping: every run of the same profile uses the same step, substeps and iterations (deterministic order, design decision ADR-029 §5 rule 2).

maxSteps.description: Largest number of steps before the run stops as nonconvergent.

solverPrepositioning.title: Solver pre-positioning
solverPrepositioning.description: Placement of the panels around the body model before the seams are closed.

method.description: Extensible vocabulary: 'd2p:around-body' (panels wrapped around the body at the landmark heights of their seams, front panels in front, back panels behind, sleeves around the arms), or extension names.

clearanceMm.description: Distance between body surface and pre-positioned panel.

bodyOffsetMm.description: Collision offset added to the body surface.

solverConvergence.title: Solver convergence
solverConvergence.description: The drape is in equilibrium when, after at least minSteps steps, no vertex moves faster than maxVelocityMmPerS.

maxVelocityMmPerS.description: Largest vertex speed in equilibrium, mm/s.

minSteps.description: Smallest number of steps before equilibrium is tested.

solverFailureLimits.title: Solver failure limits
solverFailureLimits.description: Result limits: a drape beyond one of them is failed (DRP-002).

maxPenetrationMm.description: Largest permitted depth of a cloth vertex inside the body.

maxSeamGapMm.description: Largest permitted distance between the two sewn edges of a seam after draping.

solverBudget.title: Solver budget
solverBudget.description: Budget of one drape job; a job beyond it is cancelled with a diagnostic (DRP-007).
